title: Support path extension preserves degree-zero hull membership
statement: Let Lambda be any commutative condensed ring. Let X be a qcqs scheme, tree a finite qcqs open-closed tree over X and p a path from S to X [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree]. Let N be any Lambda_S-module. If N[0] belongs to G_S [def-sfb-supported-image-generation-hull], then (p.extension N)[0] belongs to G_X. The extension is the actual composite of open extension by zero and ordinary closed direct image. No finite-model assumption on N and no coefficient admissibility assumption are needed. Root paths and empty schemes are allowed.

proof.text: For each single arrow $a$ of the support chain, its indicated functor $a_!$ is exact and triangulated on ordinary derived categories. For an open arrow it preserves derived products by the extension-by-zero limits theorem and sheaf colimits by $a_!\dashv a^*$. For a closed arrow, ordinary $a_*$ is exact, preserves derived products as the right adjoint of exact $a^*$, and preserves filtered sheaf colimits because the target is qcqs and the open complement is quasi-compact. Applied termwise these functors keep a common lower bound. They take supported finite-model generators on their sources to generators on their targets by concatenating support chains. The inverse image of $\mathcal G_{\mathrm{target}}$ under this functor is therefore an admissible class defining $\mathcal G_{\mathrm{source}}$. Induction over the chain gives $J(\mathcal G_S)\subseteq\mathcal G_X$, hence $JK[0]\in\mathcal G_X$.
